title: 225 Printable Scripture Cards Set
author: Nann Digital Art
description:
Printable Bible Verse Cards 225 Printable Scripture Cards Christian Wall Art, Faith Quotes Christian Vision Boards Bible Study Prayer Cards
Bible Verse Cards Bundle | Christian Affirmation Cards | Scripture Memory Cards | Prayer & Encouragement Printables | 15 Faith-Based Topics
Perfect for Bible Study, Prayer & Daily Devotions
Strengthen your faith, encourage your heart, and fill your days with God’s Word through this beautiful collection of 225 Printable Scripture Cards.
This premium Bible verse card bundle includes 225 carefully selected Scriptures organized into 15 uplifting topics designed to encourage, inspire, comfort, and strengthen believers in every season of life.
Perfect for daily devotionals, Bible study groups, prayer journals, church ministries, Christian gifts, homeschooling, scripture memorization, and personal encouragement.
Each card features a meaningful Bible verse that can be printed, framed, gifted, journaled with, or used as daily faith reminders.
Bring daily encouragement, peace, and inspiration into your home with these Printable Bible Verse Cards. This set includes 225 carefully chosen verses divided into 15 uplifting topics: Renewal, Thankfulness, Faith, Guidance, Hope, Strength, Peace, Purpose, Grace, Love, Family, Blessings, Overcoming Fear, Forgiveness, and Healing.
Each card is beautifully designed in a minimal, calming style that is easy on the eyes. Perfect for wall art, collage kits, journaling, devotionals, gifts, or encouragement notes.
WHAT’S INCLUDED
✓ A total of 225 unique Bible verse cards
✓ Organized into 15 Inspirational Topics
✓ High-Resolution PDF Files/ A PDF document with 25 pages, each containing 9 cards per page
✓ Sized for easy printing on Letter Size (8.5” x 11”) or A4 paper
✓ Ready-to-Print Format
✓ Instant Digital Download
✓ Single-sided design.
✓ The images are on the same layer and are NOT EDITABLE.
✓ High resolution at 300dpi.
✓ PDF file has a thank you card.
15 SCRIPTURE TOPICS INCLUDED
• Renewal & Transformation
• Thankfulness & Gratitude
• Faith & Trust in God
• Guidance & Wisdom
• Hope & Encouragement
• Strength & Courage
• Peace & Comfort
• Living with Purpose
• Grace & Mercy
• Love of Others & Friendship
• Relationships, Family & Marriage
• Blessings & Prosperity
• Overcoming Doubt, Fear & Anxiety
• Forgiveness & Reconciliation
• Healing & Restoration
PERFECT FOR
• Christian Women
• Bible Study Groups
• Prayer Journals
• Church Ministries
• Homeschool Families
• Scripture Memorization
• Daily Devotions
• Christian Gifts
• Faith-Based Businesses
• Printable Shops
PLEASE NOTE:
– Color variations may occur due to monitor differences.
INSTANT DOWNLOAD:
You can print these designs unlimited times.
Moreover, can use it to be a digital decor paper with your digital planner too!
WHY YOU’LL LOVE THIS SET
These carefully chosen Bible verses cover life’s most important spiritual needs—from finding peace during difficult seasons to growing deeper in faith and discovering God’s promises for everyday living.
Whether you use them as daily encouragement cards, scripture memory cards, journaling prompts, lunchbox notes, prayer cards, bookmarks, or framed faith decor, this collection provides lasting inspiration rooted in God’s Word.
Create meaningful moments with Scripture every day and keep God’s promises close to your heart.
